title: Declarative onboarding adapter and capability capsule for model profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a backwards-compatible API adapter that exposes a concise, declarative 'capability capsule' for every onboarded model. The capsule should surface limits (max_tokens, request_rate), supported context lengths, feature flags (streaming, function-calls, structured-output), and a stable version pin used by runtime routing. This ticket covers schema design, server-side validation, publishing flow for new models, and a compatibility shim for older consumers.
acceptance_criteria: A JSON Schema (draft-07 compatible) for capability capsule is reviewed and merged in the model-catalog repo
Create/publish endpoint accepts capsule payload and validates against schema returning clear field-level errors
Runtime routing reads pinned_version and prefers exact-version routes; falls back to capability-compatible variants when pinned version unavailable
Console and API model-list endpoints expose capsule summary (limits, context, features) with paginated responses
Backward-compatibility: clients requesting the legacy /model/profiles endpoint continue to get a compatible view for 6 months
Automated tests cover schema validation, migration strategy, and a small integration test against a dedicated runtime staging cluster
